description: What the install review writes when the installer approves the inbox fixture's route writes: the Installation's grants verbatim, and the right it gives the Installation's agent on each write target's parent (config.inbox), in a commit the installer signs. The browser's tests (browser/lib/src/plugin-route-grant.test.ts) check that the page produces exactly this; the server's (route_writes::http_tests) install it and POST.
